episodes.synopsis: Sam and Casey arrive in Balloon Town not knowing where to go next; they hope Philly the Kid can help them despite the bounty hunters on his tail.
episodes.title: High Risk, Low Reward!

episodes.synopsis: When Bessie breaks down, the trio makes a deal with Mama Hitch for repairs; Sam dreams of the last time she saw Kelby on the night Botica was attacked.
episodes.title: Grifters Gonna Grift

episodes.synopsis: Mama Hitch prepares to carve up Philly's corpse as her sons try to strip Bessie for parts; the magician reveals his true identity to the King.
episodes.title: Watch Out for the Wet Spot

episodes.synopsis: In Happy Lucky Market Town, Philly sends Casey off to buy supplies as he goes after the legendary -- and very drunk -- ronin known as 9ine.
episodes.title: 9INE

episodes.synopsis: As 9ine, Sam and Casey enjoy a night out on the town, Bessie breaks down and Philly finds himself communing with nature extremely closely.
episodes.title: 21 the Hard Way

episodes.synopsis: Philly heads to Madura City with the droids to pay a bar tab, but when they arrive they find a ghost town -- and a very unfriendly threat.
episodes.title: Unfettered

episodes.synopsis: Masked fighters attack Kelby and Odin; Lady Day continues to track Philly and dispatches a droid to locate a bounty hunter named Jojo.
episodes.title: Lady & the Kid

episodes.synopsis: After arriving in a dump town called Zenith, Sam puts her friendship lessons from Philly into practice; Case meets a droid with a gloomy outlook.
episodes.title: Turnbuckle Ex-Machina

episodes.synopsis: On the run from a giant crab, the trio falls into a deep pit and is welcomed as saviors by the strange beings living there -- but there's a catch.
episodes.title: Lullaby of the Stars

episodes.synopsis: In Squeaking Springs, Sam works as a waitress in a bar and meets a kid named Jojo as Philly finds himself in jail for murder.
episodes.title: Squeaking Springs Afternoon

episodes.synopsis: The trio reaches Gara's Keep, but things are strangely quiet; Sam, undeterred, insists on going in -- convinced that she will finally see Kelby again.
episodes.title: Innocence Lost (1)

episodes.synopsis: With Kelby captured aboard an airship and Philly in close pursuit, Sam's Cannon Buster programming takes over -- but a friend may be an enemy.
episodes.title: Innocence Lost (2)
